headline: Social Security Investment Fund: Fund Assets to Exceed 20 Billion Dinars by End of Third Quarter 2026
summary: The fund's assets are expected to exceed 20 billion dinars by the end of the third quarter of 2026. Asset growth since the start of the year reached 1.5 billion dinars.
why: Jordan's Social Security Investment Fund manages pension-related assets and invests in infrastructure and energy projects in the country.
